title: Grade 7 French — Mon, Jun 01
description: Le futur proche — Day 1 of 5: The concept (aller + infinitive) and conjugating aller
subject: french

questions.question: Last week we learned the daily routine in the present. This week: the FUTUR PROCHE. What does it express?
options: The near future — what is going to happen soon
questions.explanation: Le futur proche = the near future. It says what is GOING TO happen soon, like English 'I am going to...'.

questions.question: How is the futur proche formed?
questions.explanation: Futur proche = ALLER (conjugated in present) + INFINITIVE. E.g., 'Je vais manger.' = I am going to eat.

questions.question: Conjugate ALLER (to go) in the present tense:
options: je vais, tu vas, il va, nous allons, vous allez, ils vont
je suis, tu es, il est, nous sommes, vous êtes, ils sont
j'ai, tu as, il a, nous avons, vous avez, ils ont
je vas, tu va, il vais, nous allez, vous allons, ils vont
questions.explanation: ALLER (irregular): je vais, tu vas, il/elle va, nous allons, vous allez, ils/elles vont. You must know this to build the futur proche.

questions.question: What does 'Je vais manger' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Je vais manger' = I am going to eat. 'vais' (aller) + 'manger' (infinitive).

questions.question: Conjugate 'aller' for 'je':
questions.explanation: 'Je vais' = I go / I am going. (je vais + infinitive = futur proche)

questions.question: Conjugate 'aller' for 'tu':
questions.explanation: 'Tu vas' = you go / you are going.

questions.question: Conjugate 'aller' for 'il/elle':
questions.explanation: 'Il va' = he goes / he is going.

questions.question: Conjugate 'aller' for 'nous':
questions.explanation: 'Nous allons' = we go / we are going.

questions.question: Conjugate 'aller' for 'ils/elles':
questions.explanation: 'Ils vont' = they go / they are going.

questions.question: Complete: 'Je ___ regarder un film.' (I am going to watch a film)
questions.explanation: 'Je vais regarder un film.' je vais + infinitive 'regarder'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Tu ___ jouer au foot.' (you are going to play football)
questions.explanation: 'Tu vas jouer au foot.' tu vas + 'jouer'.

questions.question: In 'Nous allons partir', which word is the infinitive?
questions.explanation: 'Partir' is the infinitive (the unchanged verb). 'Allons' is the conjugated aller. = We are going to leave.

questions.question: What does 'Elle va étudier' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Elle va étudier' = She is going to study. 'va' (aller) + 'étudier' (infinitive).

questions.question: Why is the futur proche called 'proche' (near)?
options: Because it describes actions that will happen soon
Because it is used only with 'aller'
questions.explanation: 'Proche' = near/close. The futur proche expresses something about to happen soon, not a distant future.
